The '''Four Thrones of Cron''' was a term used in the [[Kingdom of Cron]] around [[25,130 BBY]], near the end of [[Xer VIII]]'s reign. It referred to the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Chandaar]], [[Cadinth]] and [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] of the Kingdom of Cron, and the still-independent [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] of the [[Livien League]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

The first three worlds were [[Xer's Campaigns|conquered]] by Xer.<ref name="Xim Week" /> When Xer retired, his son [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] finally [[Battle of Jhantoria|conquered]] the Livien League in [[25,127 BBY]].<ref name="Xim Week" /><ref name="TEA" /> With the Four Thrones under one crown, the Kingdom of Cron became the [[Xim's empire|Empire of Xim]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
